input: A text code (`@code` in a layout contract) and the language this computer chose (`ui-language.json` beside the other settings of this computer; without it the base language, English).
output: The text of the code from the dictionary of that language (`contracts/text/<language>.json`); a code the dictionary lacks or an unknown language is a controlled error, never a made-up text.
specification: User decision 2026-10-14: the user interface is in English and every text has a code, so the language can be chosen; the language is a setting of the computer, not of the project.
